layout.title: DiaVision | Diabetes Risk Predictor
layout.description: A polished, Vercel-ready diabetes risk predictor with a secure server-side prediction adapter and patient-friendly results.

page.heading: DiaVision - Diabetes risk predictor
page.intro: This tool helps you understand your potential risk for developing diabetes. By answering a few simple questions about your health, you'll receive personalized insights to help you make informed lifestyle choices.

simple.title: Simple Step-by-Step Flow
simple.copy: Our easy-to-use questionnaire guides you through entering your basic health details and recent lab results.

personalized.title: Personalized Insights
personalized.copy: Get a clear, visual summary of your potential diabetes risk factors and helpful recommendations based on your unique profile.

private.title: Secure & Private
private.copy: Your health data is processed securely and is never shared. Your privacy is our top priority.

comprehensive.title: Comprehensive View
comprehensive.copy: The assessment looks at how your different health factors work together to give you a complete picture of your wellness.

disclaimer.title: Important
disclaimer.body: Important Notice: This tool is designed to help you understand your health and is for educational purposes only. It does not provide a formal medical diagnosis and should never replace professional advice, testing, or treatment from your doctor.

export.connectionFailed: Could not connect to the database from this server. In MongoDB Atlas, Network Access must allow the host running this app (for Vercel, allow 0.0.0.0/0 or your deployment’s egress IPs). Ensure Vercel has the environment variable MONGODB_URI (exact name) and redeploy after changes.

welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.title: Welcome to Your Health Assessment
welcome.description: This quick questionnaire will help you understand your diabetes risk. It takes just a few minutes to complete.

quick.title: Quick & Easy
quick.copy: Answer a few straightforward questions about your health history and recent lab tests.

smart.title: Smart Analysis
smart.copy: We'll securely analyze your numbers to give you a personalized overview of your risk profile.

holistic.title: Holistic View
holistic.copy: See how different factors like weight, age, and blood sugar work together to impact your health.

tips: Have your most recent lab results handy for the best accuracy (like your blood sugar and blood pressure).
If you have never been pregnant or it doesn't apply to you, simply enter 0 for the pregnancy count.
Don't worry if you don't know your exact insulin or skin thickness levels. Just enter 0, and we'll use a standard average.
We'll ask about your family history to better understand your genetic background related to diabetes.
welcome.tipsFooter: Remember, this tool is here to educate and inform. It is not a replacement for a doctor's visit or a formal medical diagnosis.

profile.label: About You
profile.title: Let's start with the basics
profile.description: Tell us a bit about yourself. Your age and body metrics give us a helpful starting point.
profile.ageDescription: Please enter your current age in years.
profile.pregnanciesDescription: Enter 0 if this doesn't apply to you or if you've never been pregnant.
profile.bmiDescription: Your Body Mass Index (BMI) helps us understand your overall physical profile.
profile.sidebarBody: Age, weight, and health history are some of the most important baseline factors when assessing diabetes risk.

labs.label: Health Numbers
labs.title: Your recent lab results
labs.description: Enter your latest blood sugar and blood pressure readings. These are great indicators of your current wellness.
labs.glucoseDescription: Use a recent fasting test result if you have one.
labs.bloodPressureDescription: Enter your top (systolic) blood pressure number.

measurements.label: More Details
measurements.title: Additional health details
measurements.description: A few more details help make your results as accurate as possible. Don't worry if you don't know every single one.
measurements.skinDescription: Enter 0 if you don't know this number. We'll use a standard average.
measurements.insulinDescription: Enter 0 if you don't know this number. We'll use a standard average.
measurements.dpfDescription: A score representing your family history of diabetes. Usually falls between 0.1 and 1.5.

asideMissing.title: Missing info? No problem
asideMissing.copy: If you aren't sure about some of these specific details, just enter 0. The system will fill in the gaps with safe, standard averages.

asideConnecting.title: Connecting the dots
asideConnecting.copy: By looking at all these numbers together, we can give you a much better picture of your health than looking at just one number alone.

review.label: Review
review.title: Review your answers
review.description: Take a moment to check the details you've entered before we generate your personalized health insights.
nextSteps: We'll do a quick check to make sure your answers are ready to go.
Our system will securely review your health factors together.
You'll get a clear, easy-to-read summary of your potential diabetes risk on the next screen.
review.reviewFooter: Important: These results are to help you understand your health better. Please share any concerns or questions you have with your healthcare provider.

result.label: Your Results
result.title: Your Health Overview
result.description: Here is a summary of your diabetes risk assessment based on the information you provided.

actions.resultFooterBody: Go back to the review step to fix a typo, or start over from the beginning.
actions.footerTitleReview: Whenever you're ready, let's get your personalized health insights.
actions.footerTitleProgress: Move through the steps in order to complete your assessment.
